integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Vertical 9:16 first-person webcam composition. A young adult in a casual bedroom sits in front of a laptop webcam, slightly under-exposed ring light, plain wall behind them, wearing a worn t-shirt. They stare at the screen with a slightly bored expression, head resting on one hand. A small dark UI card slides in from the bottom reading "finding someone..." with three pulsing dots and a tiny spinning ring animation. At 00:01.500, the card snaps shut and a soft chime plays as the screen instantly splits into two stacked webcam windows inside a dark glassmorphic frame with thin border, slight bounce easing. The top webcam shows the first person; the bottom webcam shows a completely different young stranger, different bedroom, different lighting, headphones around their neck, completely different face. Both stare at each other in awkward silence for half a second, one tilts their head, the other blinks twice.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, a large glossy 🤪 emoji slams down from the top of the frame into the center between the two webcam windows with elastic squash-and-stretch: it elongates on impact, squashes wider, then settles with a tiny bounce. The webcam windows briefly tilt apart then snap back. Both strangers' eyebrows raise in confused recognition. A huge white numeral "3" punches in over the center, slightly tilted, with a soft percussive tick. It snaps to "2" then "1", each number bigger and more urgent, with matching ticks.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the countdown vanishes and both players snap into action. The top stranger sticks their tongue out hard and crosses their eyes, eyes squinting. The bottom stranger overdoes it — tongue out, eyes bulging, one eyebrow raised, head tilted. Quick 110% digital punch-in on the top face with a snap zoom, then match cut to 115% punch-in on the bottom face. Subtle cyan face-landmark dots and thin line graphics trace their eyebrows, eyes, and mouths as if scanning, a faint horizontal scanline sweeps across both windows. The 🤪 emoji floats gently between them as a frozen reference. Momentary frame freeze on the funniest expression for half a beat.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the two webcam windows slide outward, leaving a black center column. Two percentage counters tick rapidly upward in cyan monospaced numerals — left counter stops at "84%", right counter stops at "71%". The 84% side receives a small elastic bounce. The top stranger throws their head back in exaggerated disbelief, mouth open, hand to forehead. The bottom stranger leans toward their camera, eyes wide, hand covering their mouth, body language screaming "no way." Soft comedic silence for half a beat.

[Shot 5] At 00:09.500, a 😡 emoji drops in from above with a heavy whoosh and a low bass thud, slightly tilted, sliding into the center with a wobble settle. Both players instantly scrunch their faces — brows down, lips pursed, looking furious. Match cut to a 😭 emoji that slowly melts downward from the top, eyes turned into dripping droplets, as both players immediately slump into fake crying, lips trembling, eyebrows pinched up. Match cut to a 😏 emoji sliding sideways into frame with a smug smirk; both players tilt their heads, raise one eyebrow, attempt a smoldering half-smile that looks ridiculous with one corner of their lips curling.

[Shot 6] At 00:12.000, a fast rhythmic four-beat montage: a 😱 emoji slams in with a bright pop, both players throw hands to their cheeks, mouths in screaming O shape; quick cut to a 🤨 emoji with a single raised brow, both players mimic it with skeptical squints and slight head tilts; quick cut to a 🥴 emoji with swirling dizzy eyes, both players wobble their heads like they are drunk, eyes half-closed, smiles lopsided; quick cut to a 😜 emoji with tongue and one wink, both players stick out their tongues and wink hard. Between every emoji, percent counters flash quickly above each webcam: "92%", "67%", "88%", "95%". Each score lands with a small satisfying pop. The 95% score gets a tiny cyan confetti pixel burst around the matching webcam window.

[Shot 7] At 00:14.000, the chaos freezes. The two webcam windows lock mid-frame, both strangers caught in absurd expressions — eyes crossed, tongues out, hands in the air. The background slightly darkens. The 🤪 emoji hovers gently between them. A small monospaced line fades in at the bottom in soft cyan: "why am I actually trying this hard?" It holds for one beat. Then a tiny lowercase wordmark "emoggle" appears naturally just below, in muted white, no tagline, no call to action, no URL. The clip ends abruptly like a social-media cut.

overall_soundscape: Light playful internet sound design. A soft connection chime on match, three short percussive ticks for the countdown, a bouncy cartoon boing on each emoji slam with elastic whoosh, a rapid ticking counter sound while scores climb, a soft pop on each percentage reveal, a faint camera-shutter click during the face scan, a tiny confetti shimmer on the highest score, and a small whoosh on each emoji entrance. Background ambience stays quiet — slight room tone, no music bleed. Occasional comedic silence before a ridiculous expression lands.

non_diegetic_music: A quirky minimalist beat of muted bouncy synth plucks, a thin square-wave bass, and a tiny shaker, all sitting low in the mix, slightly off-kilter and playful, rhythmically following the emoji hits and cuts without becoming melodic or busy. Stops cleanly before the final freeze-frame.
